name: record-header
title: Record Header
description: The head of any record on its page or in a peek — where it lives, its key, icon and title renamed in place, status, meta line, chips, presence and actions.

meta.whenToUse: The top of every record page and every RecordPeek body: task, meeting, row, page, customer, project.
meta.whenNotToUse: A list page header with tabs and a primary action (PageHeader), or a section title inside a record (SectionHeading).
